m: The *dancer* straps two long poles to her legs and towers over the crowd on her **stilts**.
The *busy mother* leaps over the swinging *cane* and lands on one hand: a nimble **acrobat**.
At *dawn*, before the *moon* has set, the ministers bow before the king at the **royal court**.
A *roof* big enough to sleep a *hundred men* for the night: the roadside **inn**.
The *standing person* holds the *tethered arrow* for the archer who is sick: a loyal **stand-in**.
Sharp *grass* grows wild around an old *tombstone*: a patch of **prickly grass** that scratches your ankles.
Under the *lampshade* the chef lifts a spoon, steaming like a *cloud*, for a quick **taste test**.
The harvest from the *rice field* is set high on a *pedestal* for guests: a **serving stand**.
Under a *lid* of canvas, sellers wave a *towel* at shoppers in the busy **market**.
*Water drops* ripple across the sea like a shaken *hide*, and rise into a rolling **wave**.
Halfway down the *road* you meet a fierce *glare*, so you turn back in a quick **u-turn**.
Wrapped in a *blanket*, a hidden *booby trap* ticks inside your **chest** like a nervous heart.
Put your *mouth* right next to someone's *ear* and say it softly: a **whisper**.
The *left hand* stirs the last of the *campfire*, and all that remains is grey **ash**.
Pack a *bent knife* and a bag of *shell* money on your back: a heavy **backpack**.
*Rolling hands* wind up the paper while a *bowing man* holds the end: a long **scroll**.
Once in a while the *king* opens an extra *gate* in the calendar: a **leap month**.
A *right hand* presses the big red button and the rocket roars off the **launch pad**.
The **porter** ties the horse to a *hitching post* and, like a *kneeling man*, unloads the bags.
One *ear* pressed to the wall, *both hands* cupped around it: a sneaky **eavesdropper**.
A *right hand* holds up the glass tube and reads the red line on the **thermometer**.
The *standing person* lifts the *shoulder pole* loaded with heavy buckets: the faithful **bearer**.
A pod bursts *upstairs* on the vine, and *crumbs* of beans tumble out: a **soybean**.
*Water drops* bubble in the pot while *sun rays* warm the kitchen: a bowl of hot **soup**.
Under the *roof* stands an *altar* for the great-grandparents: the family's **ancestral hall**.
The *standing person* holds a big leaf over a *nodding head* like an umbrella: a **lotus leaf**.
A golden *towel* hangs from the clouds, waved by the mighty **sky god** above.
*Water drops* spill over the riverbanks as the *proclamation* is read: the whole **floodplain** is flooded.
A farmer flicks his *cane* and seeds fly everywhere across the field: **scattered seeds**.
The **rider** sits tall in the saddle on top of the *grain stalk* sacks and gallops off to the *north*.
On top of the *mountain* the winner blows a horn wrapped in *coiled rope*: the **triumph horn**.
Put a *lid* on the sky and the stars come out: it is **night**.
A *person* builds a small roof of sticks and lies down inside: a cosy **hut**.
A mother's *claw* rolls the egg over and out pops a *child*: a fluffy **hatchling**.
A *swarm* of sparks flies as the blade is ground on the *cliff*: a rough **whetstone**.
His *right hand* grips a walking stick as the wise old **elder** limps along.
*Trudging feet* climb up past rows of *wheat* until they reach the snowy **peak**.
A *fence* with a *cross* pushed right through the middle: a **pierced frame**.
Shake the *little fortune stick* over a *shell* and the **oracle** tells your future.
*Antlers* on top and a *silk pair* below, stuck together by the pull of a **magnet**.
A *thousand ants* march into the *mortar* and carry out the grains: a busy **husker**.
The deer with *antlers* stands ahead, holding a *moon sickle*: it leads from the **front**.
A *right hand* grabs the stem and yanks it out with the roots: a **pulled weed**.
Sweep the floor with a *comb* tied to a long stick: a homemade **broom**.
Water shoots out of a stone *cross* in the middle of the square: a sparkling **fountain**.
A *big man* lifts his arms and a *lightning bolt* strikes: a **sudden flash** lights the sky.
The **historian** hits the *bullseye* of the truth and snips the lies away with *scissors*.
The *standing person* watches over a toddler with a *blank stare*: the patient **nanny**.
A *small speech bubble* pops up over each *busy man* as the boss takes a **headcount**.
Take a slip out of the *cabinet* and lay it on the *altar*: your **ticket** to the show.
A *right hand*, another *right hand* and a third *right hand* all reach for leaves: three **leaf pickers**.
A gnarled old root dug out of the hills, covered in hairy *bristles*: precious **ginseng**.
A *cross* of bright fire streaks across the night with a long tail: a **comet**.
Little *horns* sticking up and a *slingshot* in his pocket: your cheeky **little brother**.
Climb on the *podium* in the *village* school and answer the question: a clever **schoolkid**.
A *robe* worn in the *town square* and embroidered with dragons: the **royal robe**.
The *newborn* grows up, combs his *bristles* neatly and bows politely: a true **gentleman**.
A *sparrow* on a stick turns slowly over the glowing *embers*: the smoky smell of **barbecue**.
A *moon dog* howls as the *embers* leap up into roaring **flames**.
With a *strong arm* and *two sparks* of a whip, the **elephant handler** steers the giant beast.
Pick a purple flower and drop it in your *grass basket*: a sweet little **violet**.
Behind the garden *shed* the *cashier* counts the gold of the grand **mansion**.
Pull the *plough* through the earth beside the *sun-dried meat* stall: a freshly **ploughed field**.
Wipe your brow with a *towel*, tuck up your *robe hem* and get to work on the **farm**.
Tip your *slanted cap* goodbye, go out, and then come home again: a **return trip**.
Throw the *fishing net* over the window as the *dusk moon* rises: a fine **gauze net** to stop insects.
The *chieftain* raises his cup between finger and *thumb* and calls for a **toast**.
A *white dove* perched on two thin *legs*, seen against the light: a dark **silhouette**.
A *blanket* is wrapped round each *clay jar* before it goes into the kiln: fine **pottery**.
A little window like a *mouth* opens high up under the roof: the dusty **attic**.
The *sun* rises and sets under a *blanket* of cloud, again and again: **ten days** pass.
*Sprinkles* of sparks fall from a lamp on a *tall stool*: a bright **light**.
A *big man* gets lost in the twisting hedges, turning left, then right: a giant **maze**.
A *thousand ants* try to lift a whole *village*: what a **heavy weight**.
The *confused man* scratches his head, squints and frowns at the map: a **puzzled face**.
He presses his *thumb* on the seal and gives the order: the **officer** in charge.
A *shed* stands on rich brown *soil* with pigs and hens all around: a cosy **farmstead**.
Under the *roof* something nibbles the rice sacks at night: a hungry **pest**.
A pink bloom opens on a *tree* and falls onto the *small table*: one **flower**.
A *woman* sighs over a *grain stalk* bending down in the heat: a **wilting stalk**.
Nothing but *prickly grass* and dust for miles and miles: a dry **wasteland**.
A guard holds his *halberd* and stands still in the *grass*: the **sentry** on duty.
Pour every number through a *funnel* and count them up by *heart*: the final **tally**.
*Trudging feet* and a *strong arm* dragging the rubbish out: another boring **chore**.
*Water drops* splash over your *tongue* from a bubbling stream: fresh **living water**.
*Wheat* for food and a *thumb* to pick fruit: the **longevity peach** keeps you going for a hundred years.
Under the *roof*, curled round a *spoon*, sleeps a long green **serpent**.
A *child* scatters *crumbs* for the ducks with grandpa: his little **grandson**.
Two *horns* sit on top of the *door bar* where the tracks join: two **linked rails**.
A *cross* of wood tied with *scissors* for a handle: the old man's trusty **walking staff**.
*Trudging feet* go up and up the steep slope: a long **hill climb**.
Behind a strong *fence* each *grain stalk* is piled high and dry: the round **granary**.
The *bear cub* grows up big and strong and stands on two legs: a grown **bear**.
Under the *sun*, put your best work up on the *scaffold*: a proud **showcase**.
Hide behind the *leaning cliff* and look out through the *peephole*: a round **shield**.
Under the *shed* roof, cane juice boils down into white crystals of **sugar**.
A **warrior** raises his spear at the *stop sign*: nobody passes him.
Pull your *cap* down over one *eye* to shade it from the sun: a **brimmed hat**.
A *standing person* holding a *banknote*, then another, a hundred in a line: **hundred men**.
*Water* spills on the desk and the *sun* dries it, leaving a crinkled **stack of papers**.
Two *horns* of petals rise above *three planks* of leaves: a delicate **orchid**.
Under the *roof*, the **detective** studies the scene of the strange *sacrifice*, magnifying glass in hand.
Steering the *boat* with a *war club* for a paddle: the old **boatman**.
A paper *knife* cuts *two planks* into big shoes: on goes the **clown**.
The *big man* boasts about his *leaky pot* as if it were made of gold: what a **show-off**.
*Sprinkles* of gravel and a giant *comb* of spikes laid across the road: a **roadblock**.
A pair of *scissors* snips tiny holes all over white *linen*: a strip of delicate **lace**.
Pile *goods* high on the *mountain* and they tumble down as **boulders**.
*Footsteps* go out, then a *return trip* brings them home: **back and forth**, all day long.
Pull the *bow* string back as far as *long hair* can reach: a **stretched bow**.
A *sparrow* that grew long, fancy, colourful tail *feathers*: the proud strutting **pheasant**.
Each *person* walks in under a *cloud* of chatter: the **meeting** has begun.
*Candy* poured into a *matching pair* of bowls until it spills: an **overflowing bowl**.
*Footsteps* thump in time towards the *goal line*: the army is on the **march**.
One *cart* rolls after another along the long dusty *road*: a slow **convoy**.
Two hikers on the *road* bump into each other at the *peak*: a **chance meeting**.
Look up at the *sky* and your *heart cushion* goes warm: your cheeks are **blushing**.
Feed every *mouth* from the *inner room* kitchen, tossing noodles in a big **wok**.
Cut the *grain stalk* with a *standing knife* bent into a curve: a sharp **sickle**.
A *paw print* on the floor and a cackle in the dark: the **goblin** was here.
